title: The Registrar General (Amendment) Act, 2003
text:
Legal Supplement Part A to the “Trinidad and Tobago Gazette’’, Vol. 42,
No. 40, 13th March, 2003
First Session Eighth Parliament Republic of Trinidad
and Tobago
REPUBLIC OF TRINIDAD AND TOBAGO
Act No. 7 of 2003
[L.S.]
AN ACT to amend the Registrar General Act,
Chap. 19:03
[Assented to 28th February, 2003]
ENACTED by the Parliament of Trinidad and Tobago as
Enactment
follows:—
1. This Act may be cited as the Registrar General
Short title
(Amendment) Act, 2003.

20 No. 7 Registrar General (Amendment) 2003
Section 9 amended 2. The Registrar General Act is amended in section 9
Chap. 19:03
by repealing subsection (2) and substituting the
following subsection:
“ (2) Notwithstanding subsection (1), the
Registrar General—
(a) shall not accept payment for any
transaction after three o’clock in the
afternoon except where a member of
the public desirous of transacting such
business was in the office at the said
three o’clock;
(b) may with the approval of the Minister
by notification published in the Gazette
and at least one daily newspaper in
circulation in Trinidad and Tobago—
(i) close the Office of the
Registrar General for the
transaction of business on
any working day; or
(ii) alter the length of the period
referred to in subsection (1)
for the transaction of business
on any working day.”.
Passed in the House of Representatives this 22nd
day of November, 2002.
J. SAMPSON-JACENT
Clerk of the House

No. 7 Registrar General (Amendment) 2003 21
Passed in the Senate this 18th day of February,
2003.
D. DOLLY
Clerk of the Senate
Senate Amendment agreed to by the House of
Representatives this 21st day of February, 2003.
J. SAMPSON-JACENT
